defs.label: Find areas / boxes
defs.help: Records grouped by area, box or other grouping.

defs.label: Map
defs.help: Area pins (shared with every archive) or, for archives with coordinates, one point per record.

defs.label: Site photo
defs.help: Map | Site photo buttons on the area map (the excavation orthomosaic).

defs.label: Viewer background
defs.help: Starting background of the full-screen viewer. Each archive's editor can fine-tune it.

defs.label: Image pairs on cards
defs.help: Show both images (e.g. obverse and reverse) side by side on cards.

defs.label: Scale bar and actual size
defs.help: Needs a size column (viewer.scale in site.json).

defs.label: Info pages
defs.help: An Info tab with pages about the archive and the project (About, The Isthmia archives, Methodology, Takedown policy). New sites start with placeholder text from core/pages/; edit it in each site's editor: Tools → Info pages.

defs.label: In the combined site
defs.help: Include this archive's records in the combined Isthmia site.

defs.label: Editor
defs.help: The archive's editor (records, names, pins, viewer), here on the admin pages under Editor. Opens only with the GitHub key; the public site has no editing.
